title: RBAC v2 migration: safety-net orchestration, dry-run validation, and customer notification framework
creator: Ayesha Malik
description: Background: We are migrating authorization state from RBAC v1 to RBAC v2 to support richer permission sets, tenant-scoped roles, and improved audit fidelity. This ticket defines a migration orchestration that minimizes customer risk by layering (1) a non-destructive dry-run verification, (2) an audit-preserving streaming backfill option, (3) a dual-read parity checker, and (4) a staged notification and opt-out window for customers with bespoke integrations. Scope: orchestration logic, backfill worker config, parity checking service, admin escape-hatches, runbooks, and customer comms templates. Out of scope: UI RBAC policy editor work and end-user-facing consent flows (tracked separately).
acceptance_criteria: Dry-run mode can be enabled per-org and produces a parity report that shows >99.9% field-level agreement between v1 and v2 mappings over 72h of sampled traffic.
Streaming backfill can be started with 'audit-preserving' flag that writes all transformed events to the audit stream and marks original v1 IDs for traceability.
Dual-read parity checker runs as a continuous job with an alert if discrepancy rate exceeds 0.1% over a 1h window.
Admin maintenance-mode API and time-limited 'escape tokens' allow operators to route a single org to RBAC v1 behavior without data mutation for emergency rollback.
Customer notification templates and a 14-day opt-out grace period are published and approved by legal and support.
Runbook for cutover + rollback is reviewed by SRE, Security, and Support and linked from the ticket.
updates: 2025-02-18: Initial design review with Security and SRE. Agreed to keep dry-run immutable (no writes) and to add streaming audit writes during full backfill.
2025-02-25: Implemented parity-checker prototype, integrated with sampling proxy. Early results: 0.06% mismatches driven by legacy role aliases.
2025-03-01: Legal reviewed customer comms draft; requested explicit mention of data retention and audit exports.
2025-03-04: Support runbook added; scheduled canary orgs for week of 2025-03-10.
decisions: Do immutable dry-run vs mutable trial: chose immutable dry-run to avoid accidental data divergence during validation. Trade-off: longer validation period required for edge cases.
Backfill strategy: streaming audit-preserving backfill chosen over bulk DB rewrite to allow progressive verification and easier rollback if needed.
Opt-out model: 14-day grace window with explicit org-level opt-out endpoint. Trade-off: delays final cutover for some orgs but reduces support incidents.
testing_plan: Synthetic workload replay for 7 days using anonymized prod traces via the staging-sim cluster.
Dry-run sampling: enable for 10% of requests for 48h across 3 representative customer orgs and compare parity reports.
End-to-end test: run streaming backfill in staging with audit log sink pointed to a test ELK pipeline; validate retention and traceability.
Chaos: simulate role-store lag and transient permission-store unavailability to verify maintenance-mode behavior and alerts.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Ready): finalize runbooks, legal-approved customer comms, SRE on-call schedule.
Phase 1 (Dry-run): enable per-org dry-run for opt-in customers and canary orgs; collect parity metrics for 72h.
Phase 2 (Controlled backfill): run streaming backfill for canaries with audit-preserving writes; monitor parity and customer-reported errors.
Phase 3 (Staged cutover): wave-based migration by org size with 14-day opt-out window; use auto-fallback to v1 for severe regressions.
Phase 4 (Finalization): disable dual-read, mark migration complete, provide customers with exportable audit trail and migration report.
monitoring_and_alerting: Alerts: P0 if parity_mismatch_rate > 0.1% sustained for 1h across more than 3 orgs, P1 for audit_write_errors > 0.5% 5m.
Dashboards: per-org migration health, open opt-outs, recent admin escape activations, top mismatch reasons.
rollback_plan: Soft rollback: enable per-org maintenance-mode to route enforcement to v1 behavior (no data mutation).
Full rollback: stop streaming backfill; run compensating backfill to restore v1-derived fields from audit stream if any writable mutations occurred.
Communication: notify affected customers within 1 hour of rollback, open a high-priority incident channel, and capture RCA within 72h.
customer_communication: Pre-migration notice (30 days): overview of benefits, expected impact, opt-out instructions, link to migration FAQ.
Canary notice (7 days before canary): request for feedback and contact for bespoke integrations.
Opt-out confirmation: API and console opt-out acknowledgement with an expiration date for the grace window.
Post-migration report: per-org migration summary, audit export link, and contact for disputes.
